name: keys-vault

metadata.description: Overrides the @nx/vitest-inferred target's `inputs`, which only cover this project's own files. `boundaries.test.ts` runs Nx's module-boundaries rule through Oxlint with the options of `.oxlintrc.json`, so a change to `.oxlintrc.json`, to Oxlint, @nx/oxlint, Nx or TypeScript must re-run it. Setting `inputs` REPLACES the inferred array, so the first six entries are the inferred defaults re-declared.

test-integration.description: Run the KEK provider contract and the token, rotation and policy suites against a Vault dev server in a container (testcontainers). Requires a running Docker daemon. CI's integration job runs it when the project is affected.
